# Product Grid

`commerce/product-grid` &middot; section-level &middot; category: commerce

## Purpose

Products in a responsive grid of 1 to 4 columns with an optional heading and a view-all button. Card style is configurable.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `products` | products |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `intro` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Two columns of default cards.
- **one-column**: One product per row. Sets `columns: 1`.
- **three-column**: Three columns. Sets `columns: 3`, `align: center`.
- **four-column**: Four columns of minimal cards. Sets `columns: 4`, `cardVariant: minimal`, `align: center`.
- **minimal**: Three columns of minimal cards. Sets `columns: 3`, `cardVariant: minimal`.
- **editorial**: Two columns of editorial cards. Sets `cardVariant: editorial`.
- **luxury**: Three columns of luxury cards. Sets `columns: 3`, `cardVariant: luxury`.
- **playful**: Two columns of playful cards. Sets `cardVariant: playful`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileColumns` | one of `1`, `2` | `1` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `columns` | one of `2`, `1`, `3`, `4` | `2` |
| `cardVariant` | one of `default`, `minimal`, `luxury`, `editorial`, `playful` | `"default"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `headingAlign` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `paddingY` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingY"` |
| `paddingX` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `columnPadding` | spacing | `"@spacing.sm"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.md"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileColumns`: `1`, `2`. How many columns per row on phones.
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Each row is a table with exact widths. mobileColumns is ignored. | Stacking works. Gmail on non-Google accounts drops media queries and shows the desktop layout. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('commerce/product-grid', {
  "heading": "Our best sellers",
  "intro": "The pieces our customers reach for again and again.",
  "products": [
    {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/400x400/png?text=Linen%20Shirt",
        "alt": "The Coastal linen shirt in sand"
      },
      "name": "Coastal Linen Shirt",
      "description": "Made to be worn every day.",
      "price": "$120.00",
      "url": "https://example.com/products/linen-shirt",
      "cta": {
        "label": "Shop now",
        "href": "https://example.com/products/linen-shirt"
      },
      "badge": "Best seller",
      "salePrice": "$96.00",
      "discount": "Save 20%"
    },
    {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/400x400/png?text=Canvas%20Tote",
        "alt": "A navy canvas tote bag"
      },
      "name": "Everyday Canvas Tote",
      "description": "Made to be worn every day.",
      "price": "$68.00",
      "url": "https://example.com/products/canvas-tote",
      "cta": {
        "label": "Shop now",
        "href": "https://example.com/products/canvas-tote"
      }
    },
    {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/400x400/png?text=Wool%20Socks",
        "alt": "Three pairs of merino socks in grey"
      },
      "name": "Merino Sock 3-pack",
      "description": "Made to be worn every day.",
      "price": "$32.00",
      "url": "https://example.com/products/wool-socks",
      "cta": {
        "label": "Shop now",
        "href": "https://example.com/products/wool-socks"
      },
      "badge": "New"
    },
    {
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/400x400/png?text=Cotton%20Tee",
        "alt": "A white heavyweight cotton tee"
      },
      "name": "Heavyweight Tee",
      "description": "Made to be worn every day.",
      "price": "$45.00",
      "url": "https://example.com/products/cotton-tee",
      "cta": {
        "label": "Shop now",
        "href": "https://example.com/products/cotton-tee"
      }
    }
  ],
  "cta": {
    "label": "View all best sellers",
    "href": "https://example.com/collections/best-sellers"
  }
}) ]]
```
